items.case: A computer is slow with low CPU usage.
items.answer: Inspect memory and storage performance as well as individual processes; CPU alone does not identify the cause.
items.evidence: Record resource utilization over time and compare with baseline.
items.pitfall: Do not assume all slowness is caused by CPU.

items.case: An event screenshot lacks a timestamp.
items.answer: Retrieve the source event and preserve its timestamp, origin, and uncertainty.
items.evidence: Record event identifier and source time.
items.pitfall: An image alone cannot establish chronology.

items.case: A beginner has only a phone for coursework.
items.answer: Use a fictional browser training environment and explicitly authorized systems.
items.evidence: Explain the boundaries of simulated commands.
items.pitfall: A browser simulator is not a real shell.

items.case: A command displays an invalid-option error.
items.answer: Use documented help to correct syntax before a safe retry.
items.evidence: Show the original error and corrected invocation.
items.pitfall: Extra privilege cannot fix malformed options.

items.answer: This is within RFC1918 private space; reachability depends on network routing and policies.
items.evidence: Classify the range and describe expected network path.
items.pitfall: Private addresses do not guarantee confidentiality.

items.case: A record has text where an integer is expected.
items.answer: Check the field type and handle invalid input explicitly before calculations.
items.evidence: Test valid, missing and malformed examples.
items.pitfall: Valid JSON can contain invalid value types.

items.case: A worker sees an unexpected password reset alert.
items.answer: Use a known trusted portal to inspect account events and report through approved channels.
items.evidence: Record the alert time and independent confirmation.
items.pitfall: The alert alone does not prove compromise.

items.case: A laptop is restored from an old image.
items.answer: Verify software updates, approved configuration and application behavior before reconnecting.
items.evidence: Compare patch levels and restore tests.
items.pitfall: Old images can contain outdated security settings.

items.case: A report screenshot contains personal information.
items.answer: Redact unnecessary fields in shared copies and restrict originals.
items.evidence: Document provenance and access to source material.
items.pitfall: Security reports still require privacy safeguards.

items.case: A monitoring alert affects a safety-critical task.
items.answer: Escalate confirmed impact, responsible owner and interim safeguard promptly.
items.evidence: Include severity, timestamp and next update.
items.pitfall: Do not delay urgent escalation for complete certainty.
